question.text: Role of ethylene glycol in the radiator of vehicles is to

options.text: Decrease the freezing point of water in the winter and increase the boiling point of water in the summer
Only decrease the freezing point of water
Only increase the boiling point of water

solution.text: When ethylene glycol is added to <math><msub><mrow><mtext>H</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mtext>O</mtext></math> as antifreeze, it decreases the freezing point of <math><msub><mrow><mtext>H</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mtext>O</mtext></math> in winter and increase the boiling point of water in the summer.
